Honest compat-slot projection remains only where the surface is intentionally a compatibility/debug seam rather than live execution.

description: Follow-on audit bead under `bd-lfa1`. After the live execution cleanup, the repo still exposed the old `from_legacy_i32` / `to_legacy_i32` method names across host snapshot projection, CLI display, HAL compatibility boundaries, COM compatibility shims, and runtime/JIT tests. Outcome: those remaining projector surfaces now use explicit compat-slot naming (`from_compat_slot_i32` / `project_compat_slot_i32`) so the residual compatibility lane is visible and no longer masquerades as an ambient runtime token path.

title: Repair case-preserving procedure, module, and class naming across local resolution and project entry discovery
description: Follow-on audit bead under `bd-lfa1`. Delivered: authored/display casing now survives the compiler/project/CLI naming pipeline while lookup remains case-insensitive. Local procedure calls no longer drop helper functions such as `MakeBuf` when array return types appear in the signature, module `VB_Name` attributes preserve authored casing, runtime metadata/CLI entry discovery keep authored module/class/procedure names, and the host snapshot path now projects entry-procedure slots by runtime metadata instead of slicing from register zero when helper procedures appear before `Main`. Evidence: `cargo test -p oxvba-cli --quiet`, `cargo test -p oxvba-host source_snapshot_uses_entry_procedure_slots_when_helper_precedes_main_vm_and_jit -- --nocapture`, and `cargo test -p oxvba-host --test pointer_helpers_end_to_end -- --nocapture`.

title: Retire sentinel COM name-to-token lowering from the live path
description: Audit finding. The remaining live sentinel lowering is now retired. `DynamicMemberSelector::Name` no longer lowers to token `-1`; token-backed requests still lower, while name-backed requests now require authoritative metadata resolution or fail honestly. The deterministic/projection late-bound path continues to resolve real names through current metadata where available.

title: Replace synthetic projection handle constants with state-owned identity
description: Audit finding. Deterministic/projection COM activation still depends on raw synthetic handles like `5_004` and hashed fallback identities, and many host tests still assert those exact numbers. Move projection activation fully onto state-owned `ComObjectToken` allocation/binding identity, preserve truthful ProgID/metadata association, and migrate evidence away from hardcoded handle numerics.

title: Retire transitional COM callback-token interrogation helpers
description: Audit finding. The transitional HAL/adapter callback-token interrogation helpers are now retired. The typed `ComHal` event callback methods remain the live path, the temporary legacy wrapper names have been removed from the null/wasm/standard adapter test seams, and the HAL draft no longer describes those legacy interrogation helpers as still present. Any remaining callback transport work should now be tracked separately from this wrapper-retirement lane.

title: Reduce VM and JIT dependence on runtime_value_legacy_token compatibility projection
description: Audit finding. Large areas of VM semantics and JIT runtime helpers projected `RuntimeValue` back through `runtime_value_legacy_token(...)`, especially string, arithmetic, comparison, date/time, intrinsic, finance, collection, and compatibility-carrier helpers. This lane is now delivered: the dominant string-producing intrinsics, the bounded `Split`/`Join` lane, value-position `Like`, the bounded `MidStmt` mutation lane, the shared division/branch truthiness coercion path, the main char/format helper cluster, the bounded math/date helper cluster, tag-introspection and PRNG seed helpers, scalar arithmetic/comparison, the residual non-COM compatibility carriers, and the remaining JIT finance/collection helpers now use explicit typed compatibility or explicit tagged-array behavior instead of `runtime_value_legacy_token(...)`.

description: Child bead under `bd-lfa1.5`. Deliver typed text coercion for the dominant VM/JIT string-producing intrinsic lane so concat, slice, case, replace, trim, compare, and related helpers no longer round-trip through `runtime_value_legacy_token(...)` for common scalar/date operands. Scope includes syncing host evidence away from old integer-slot expectations while leaving unsupported adjacent string lanes explicit if they still need separate typed semantics work.

title: Retire legacy-token projection from the non-COM compatibility carrier lane
description: Child bead under `bd-lfa1.5`. title: Retire legacy-token projection from the JIT finance and collection helper lane

title: Retire legacy-token projection from the bounded Split and Join intrinsic lane

title: Retire legacy-token projection from the shared division and branch-truthiness lane

description: Audit finding. Date coercion still rejects many textual date shapes with `DateValue string format is not yet supported` / `CDate string format is not yet supported`. Outcome: added honest Windows native boundary cells for `Currency` and `Date` in addition to the earlier scalar/LongPtr subset, with focused VM/JIT evidence through `OleAut32.VarCyFromI4` and `OleAut32.VarDateFromStr`. Residual unsupported shapes remain explicit for types that still lack a truthful native boundary representation.
